message: Morning all. Quick heads up — standup is moving to 9:15 today, I have a call until then.
Got it. I'll use the extra time to finish writing up my notes on the API refactor.
Works for me. Also, did anyone watch the game last night? That comeback in the 4th quarter was insane.
I fell asleep before halftime lol. Who won?
They won by 3. It was a nail-biter. Dan sent me like 6 voice messages during it.
I regret nothing. Anyway, morning everyone. I'm still dealing with the flaky tests in the payments module.
Yeah those have been broken since last Thursday. I think it's a race condition in the mock timer setup.
That's what I thought too. I've been trying to reproduce it locally but it only seems to fail on CI.
Classic CI-only bug. Check if the CI runner has a different timezone set — I've been burned by that before.
Oh that's actually a really good point. I'll check the runner config.
Okay I'm back. Let's do standup. Carol, want to kick us off?
Sure. Yesterday I wrapped up the user profile page — it's in review. Today I'm starting on the notification settings UI. No blockers.
Yesterday I finished the first pass of the API refactor doc. Today I'm presenting it to Alice for feedback, then starting implementation. No blockers.
Yesterday I was debugging the payments tests. Today I'll dig into the CI timezone thing Eve mentioned. Blocked a little until I figure that out.
Yesterday I deployed the updated search indexer to staging. Today I'm monitoring it for any anomalies and writing up the deployment notes. No blockers.

Great. I'm reviewing Bob's refactor doc this morning, then I have a client call at 2pm about the reporting feature. Heads up that they want to move the delivery date up — I'll share details after the call.
Move it up? By how much?
Unknown until after the call. Don't panic yet.
Famous last words.
Lmao. Alright let's have a good day everyone.
Alice, I've dropped the refactor doc in the shared drive. Lmk when you're ready to go through it.
Reading it now. Overall this looks solid. One thing — you're proposing to deprecate the v1 endpoints immediately. Can we do a grace period instead? Some clients are still on v1.
Yeah that's fair. I was thinking 30 days but I wasn't sure if that was too short. 60?
Let's do 60 days with a deprecation warning header on all v1 responses starting immediately. That gives clients time to migrate and keeps us legally covered.
Perfect. I'll update the doc and add a migration guide outline. Do we want to email affected clients directly?
Yes. Loop in Jemma on the email — she handled client comms last time and has the templates.
On it.
Eve you were completely right — CI runner is set to UTC but our mock dates were hardcoded in EST. Tests pass now.
I knew it! Classic. Make sure you add a comment in the test file so nobody falls into that trap again.
Already done. Pushing the fix now.
Nice. Can you also check if the same issue affects the billing module tests? I vaguely remember seeing a similar failure there a few weeks ago.
Good call. I'll check after lunch.
Hey, slightly off topic but has anyone used Notion AI for meeting notes? I'm so tired of manually summarizing our weekly syncs.
I tried it for a bit. It's decent but it struggles with technical jargon. Kept summarizing 'API refactor' as 'project restructuring' which was useless.
I just use Otter.ai for transcription and then paste into Claude to summarize. Works pretty well.
That's basically what we're building lol.
Ah. Right.
Haha. Okay I'll hold off then and see how our own thing turns out.
Noted, Carol. Good motivation to actually finish it.
I'll need Jim to work on the transcription element tomorrow, but he's currently sleeping.
Search indexer is looking stable on staging. 99.8% query success rate over the last 2 hours, p95 latency down by 40ms compared to the old version.
That's a great improvement. What changed?
Two things: switched to batch writes instead of individual document updates, and added a local cache for repeated queries within 60 seconds. The cache hit rate is already at 34%.
Solid. Can we target prod deployment for tomorrow morning, before traffic picks up?
I'd prefer to let it run on staging overnight first. Monday morning?
Works for me. Put it on the calendar.
Done. 8am Monday, I'll own the deployment.
Lunch plans? I'm thinking the Thai place on 5th.
Yes please. I've been craving their green curry for weeks.
I'm in. Bob? Alice?
Can't today, eating at my desk to get the refactor doc updated before EOD. Bring me back something?
I have a prep call at 1 for the 2pm client thing. Grab me the tofu basil if you go, I'll pay you back.
Consider it done. Leaving in 10.
Carol — Alice mentioned you have the client email templates. Can you send them over? I need to draft the v1 deprecation notice.
Just got back! Sure, I'll send the templates now. There's one specifically for breaking changes that should work well.
Perfect, thanks.
Shared the folder in Drive. Also, the Thai place has a new mango sticky rice dessert. It was incredible. Bob you made a mistake.
I know. I regret everything.
Okay, client call is done. As suspected — they want the reporting feature two weeks earlier. New deadline is May 23rd instead of June 6th.
Two weeks?! What do we cut?
The client agreed to drop the custom branding on reports for now. So we're building: core report generation, PDF export, scheduled delivery. Custom branding goes to v1.1.
PDF export and scheduled delivery in two weeks is still aggressive.
I know. I'm scheduling a scope planning session for tomorrow 10am. Everyone please come having thought about what's actually achievable.
Will do. The API refactor might need to be partially deprioritized for this. I can stub the new endpoints and keep v1 live longer if needed.
That's exactly the kind of trade-off I want to discuss tomorrow. Good thinking.
Should I hold off on the notification settings UI and pivot to the report UI instead?
Yes. Please do that. Notification settings can wait — reports are now the priority.
What about the billing module test audit I was going to do this afternoon?
Quick check is still worth doing — if there are broken tests we need to know. But don't go deep on it, just flag anything that looks similar to the payments issue.
Got it. Will do a shallow audit and report back.
Random question — are we doing anything for the team offsite this quarter? Last quarter's escape room was really fun.
I heard Alice is looking at go-karts.
Ha — yes, I was looking at it. There's a track about 20 minutes away. But now with the deadline crunch I might push the offsite to early June.
Go-karts sounds amazing. I will absolutely embarrass all of you.
Big talk from someone who got lost in the escape room for 10 minutes.
That corridor was POORLY LABELED.
I will be keeping score at go-karts. Just so everyone knows.
Same. Alice put it on the calendar, deadline or not, we need this.
Okay okay. I'll look at dates for the first weekend of June. No promises yet.
Billing module audit done. Found two tests with the same hardcoded EST timestamps. Fixed them and pushed. No other issues.
Good catch. Thanks for the fast turnaround.
Nice. I've finished updating the refactor doc with the 60-day deprecation plan. Also started on the migration guide — it's rough but it's there.
Great. Let's review it together tomorrow after the scope planning session. Can you share a preview of the deprecation email draft too?
I'll have a draft in the shared doc by EOD.
I've pivoted to the report UI. Setting up the component structure now. Should have a wireframe-level skeleton done by tomorrow morning.
Perfect timing for the planning session. Bring it along.
Deployment notes for the search indexer are done and in Confluence. Also added a runbook section for rollback in case anything goes sideways Monday.
Excellent. That's exactly the kind of prep I like to see. Thanks Eve.
Eve out here making us all look bad.
Just wait until go-karts.

Alright everyone, good day considering the curveball. Quick EOD summary: scope planning tomorrow 10am (mandatory, come prepared), Carol pivoting to report UI, Bob has deprecation draft due EOD, search indexer deploying Monday 8am. Get some rest.
Draft is up in the doc. Night all.
Night. Someone remind me about the planning session tomorrow, I always forget.
I'll ping you at 9:45. Night!
Night everyone. Alice — seriously consider the go-karts.
I'm considering it. Night.
